description: This file is a shell script named 'pr_cycle.sh' that manages review lifecycle dates for components based on metadata.yaml files in a repository. It provides commands to start, stop, and clear review cycles, and offers help instructions. The script includes functions for listing components, resolving metadata paths, date calculations, and report regeneration.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Lists components by finding metadata.yaml files and processing their paths.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and lists available components.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Returns the full path to a component's metadata.yaml given its name.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Adds a specified number of business days to a given date.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Clears lifecycle date entries in the metadata.yaml file.

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Regenerates the RAG status report by executing an external script.
